name: files_getfilep

ownership.argument: Astrolink calls this as F_FILES_GETFILEP(filelist, fd) while walking tasks in nxsched_foreach. The list it receives is the group-embedded one at GROUP_FILELIST, which on this image is a {u8 rows; row-pointer array at +4} structure.

provenance.source: Same fd arithmetic as fs_getfilep but with the file list passed in: rows pointer array at list+4, row pointer array[fd >> 3], entry at +32 * (fd & 7), returns NULL unless inode at file+16 and refcount at file+4 are nonzero, and increments the refcount.

notes: Astrolink calls this as F_FILES_GETFILEP(filelist, fd) while walking tasks in nxsched_foreach. The list it receives is the group-embedded one at GROUP_FILELIST, which on this image is a {u8 rows; row-pointer array at +4} structure.
